summary: Kilroy Realty, L.P. entered into a Fifth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement on June 12, 2026, establishing a $1.25 billion senior unsecured revolving credit facility with an accordion feature allowing up to $1.7 billion. The filing is a routine entry into a material definitive agreement for a revolving credit facility, used for general corporate purposes including acquisitions. No special-situation event, such as a merger, tender offer, or activist campaign, is described. The filing merely updates the company's existing credit facility terms with JPMorgan Chase. This is an ordinary financing arrangement, not a special situation.
